posts.body:
[WIP] SOO – CC (Working Title)
First-Person Narrative Dungeon Crawler RPG
​
Credits to:
@MGC
for allowing me to use the Source Code and Modifying his FPLE 1.5 Script (both Ruby side and *.dll-source code)
SOO-CC is still very much under active development. The current focus has been on implementing core mechanics, scripts, and coding. All visuals seen so far are placeholders and do not reflect the final art or environments. A playable demo is expected in early 2026, with playtesting videos and a trailer to be released beforehand.
For furher updates you can checkout my profile; I use it as some sort of "blog".
- - - - - UPDATE: 16.12.2025 - - - - -
​
SECTION A: SYNOPSIS
Spoiler
SOO-CC (Working Title)
is a first-person dungeon crawler RPG with a strong narrative focus, built almost entirely (99%) by me over the course of nearly
four years
— and still actively in development.
The game is developed in
RPG Maker XP
, using
MGC’s FPLE (First Person Labyrinth Explorer) script (v1.5)
with permission, which has been
heavily modified and extended
to suit explaining gameplay systems, narrative structure, and world reactivity. Nearly every aspect of the engine has been reworked, replaced, or expanded through custom systems and original code.
SOO-CC is both
story-driven and world-driven
, featuring variable pacing that rewards exploration, observation, and thoughtful decision-making. Player choices are tightly intertwined with both narrative outcomes and gameplay mechanics — consequences are persistent and meaningful.
Set in a futuristic universe split between
the Real World
and
the Cyber World
, the game explores themes of identity, control, and existence. Both worlds are reactive, interconnected, and shaped by player actions.
Designed primarily for
niche and hardcore players
, SOO-CC also includes difficulty and accessibility options for those who wish to experience the story with less mechanical pressure. At its core, this is a passion project that prioritizes
atmosphere, mystery, emotional weight, and narrative depth
.
IMAGES / SCREENSHOTS
Spoiler
Screenshots will be added throughout development.
Current images represent
test environments and early visual prototypes
, used primarily to validate mechanics, scale, and first-person navigation.
More visually cohesive environments are planned as development progresses.
First Person View inside FPLE Map (Test Map)
Enhanced Menu including Hub, Message System & Options
Overworld HUD with Informations & Trackers
Complete reworked Battle System in Design and Function featuring a Battle Log, Status Icons & more
Calendar System including a Quest Tracker, Date, Time of Day and Day Counter.
All contents of the Screenshots are subject to change. Textures, Imagery and Placeholders to be changed.
SECTION B: CHARACTERS
Spoiler
The narrative revolves around
four central characters
, including the player character. These individuals play crucial roles in shaping the story and its outcomes.
In addition:
Multiple
NPCs, factions, and bosses
are currently in concept or early implementation.
Characters are
extremely important
to the narrative structure.
Factions and groups exist within the world; siding with them may grant benefits, unlock paths, or introduce long-term consequences.
Characters react dynamically to player choices through:
Dialogue changes
Behavioral shifts
Altered relationships
Possible changes to their fate
Moral ambiguity is a core element — no choice is purely good or evil.
SECTION C: STORYLINE / PLOT
Spoiler
Vision Corp once claimed to revolutionize medical science by separating the
mind from the body
, allowing human consciousness to exist safely within a digital environment. What began as medical progress slowly shifted into exploitation.
Healing was replaced by ambition.
Care was replaced by control.
Over time, competing interests, hidden agendas, and long chains of decisions pushed the system beyond its limits — until one day, it failed.
Minds and bodies were torn apart. Permanently — or so it seems.
In SOO-CC, the player investigates fractured environments across both worlds, uncovering fragments of truth while questioning reality itself. The story unfolds through exploration, environmental storytelling, and reactive character interactions.
This is not a tale driven by a single catastrophic moment, but by
years of manipulation, quiet decisions, and unseen influence
.
This is not just a story about what happened.
It’s about
why
,
who
, and whether everything — mind and soul — can ever be restored.
SECTION D: SETTING AND WORLD DEVELOPMENT
Spoiler
The game world is structured as a
hub-based, semi-open environment
, made possible through extensive modifications to the FPLE system.
Key elements:
Two distinct worlds:
The Real World
– grounded, controlled, and familiar
The Cyber World
– abstract, unstable, and governed by rules that are constantly breaking
Both worlds are
mechanically and visually distinct
Environmental storytelling is a
core pillar
, often conveying information without direct exposition
Locations change subtly (or dramatically) based on player choices
The Cyber World follows internal logic — but that logic is fragile, unpredictable, and subject to collapse.
DEVELOPMENT STATUS / MECHANICS
Spoiler
Current State:
Core mechanics: ~99% implemented, ongoing fine-tuning
Story: rough outline and core themes completed, writing in progress
Visuals: early-stage; test environments currently in place
Time working on this Project (according to Steam): 1002.8 Hours (roughly 42 straight days) ( (as of December 16th 2025)
Custom Systems & Code (selection):
A major development focus has been the extensive modification of MGC’s FPLE (First Person Labyrinth Explorer) script. The system now supports transparency, vertical traversal of up to six tiles in height, and a greatly expanded visual set — increasing from the original 8 floor, wall, and ceiling sets to 48 unique textures/tiles. Core rendering and resource handling were reworked to ensure smooth gameplay despite the increased complexity. Additionally, a custom FPLE map pre-loader has been implemented to reduce loading interruptions, though this system is still being refined. This took roughly 1 Year of developement itself,
Custom menus tailored to game needs
Calendar system tied directly to narrative and mechanics
HP cost system for battles
Status icons for enemies and player characters
Dynamic HP-based sprite changes
Custom dialogue system
Windowskin manager
Difficulty modifier
Various battle-related systems
Separate equipment system
External hub system
Mini-map system
Fate system after battle
Gacha system
Multiple FPLE extensions (HUD, timers, etc.)
Cycle System (Similar to SMT's Moon Phases)
and more
While inspired by long-standing RPG Maker community work, many systems were rewritten or reimagined to fit SOO-CC’s design goals. (Yes — some base code was hardcoded early on. Lessons were learned.)
The game also serves as a
homage to the Shin Megami Tensei and Persona series
, which heavily influenced its themes and atmosphere.
Next Up:
Building a Tech-Demo with all Core Mechanics that will be distributed along aleady chosen Play-Testers.
(Scheduled for Early 2026)
DOWNLOAD LINK
Spoiler
No public demo available yet.
A playable build is planned once core visuals and narrative pacing reach a stable milestone.
ABOUT ME
I hold a degree in
Communication and Design
and currently work as a
System Administrator
. Coding has become a passion over the past few years, and design has always been a central part of my life. I am a lifelong gamer, and creating my own game has been a dream I’ve pursued for years. After countless attempts, I now feel I have the experience, knowledge, and dedication to bring my vision to life.
I do not use AI; everything in the game is crafted using the resources I have. My workflow relies on “older” software, including
Photoshop 2020
and
Cinema 4D R13
, all running on an older laptop. I chose
RPG Maker XP
not only for the challenge but also because of the emotional connection it holds — it’s where my RPG Maker journey began.
While newer versions of RPG Maker could offer more features, my goal is to push XP to its limits and demonstrate what it is truly capable of. The process can be frustrating and obsessive at times, but the moments when everything comes together make the journey deeply rewarding.
​
